use implementation::OnceLock;
use std::sync::{Arc, Barrier};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
static STATIC: OnceLock<u32> = OnceLock::new();
struct Payload(Arc<AtomicUsize>, Box<[usize]>);
impl Drop for Payload { fn drop(&mut self) { self.0.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed); } }
fn main() {
    assert_eq!(*STATIC.get_or_init(|| 17), 17);
    let c = OnceLock::<String>::new();
    let panic = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| c.get_or_init(|| panic!("initialization failed"))));
    assert!(panic.is_err());
    assert!(c.get().is_none());
    assert_eq!(c.get_or_init(|| String::from("retry")), "retry");
    for _ in 0..8 {
        let c = Arc::new(OnceLock::new());
        let entered = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
        let release = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
        let drops = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
        let start = Arc::new(Barrier::new(9));
        let threads: Vec<_> = (0..8).map(|_| {
            let (c, entered, release, drops, start) = (c.clone(), entered.clone(), release.clone(), drops.clone(), start.clone());
            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                start.wait();
                let p = c.get_or_init(|| {
                    entered.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    while release.load(Ordering::Acquire) == 0 { std::thread::yield_now(); }
                    Payload(drops, vec![13, 29, 47].into_boxed_slice())
                });
                assert_eq!(&*p.1, &[13, 29, 47]);
            })
        }).collect();
        start.wait();
        while entered.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == 0 { std::thread::yield_now(); }
        assert!(c.get().is_none());
        release.store(1, Ordering::Release);
        for t in threads { t.join().unwrap(); }
        assert_eq!(entered.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
        assert_eq!(drops.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 0);
        drop(c);
        assert_eq!(drops.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
    }
    println!("host reset/contention/drop ok");
}
